description: A bottom alert sheet that asks the user to confirm or cancel an action.
overview:
`Confirm` wraps `AlertSheet` with `dismissible` set to `false` by default, so the sheet closes only through one of its buttons.

`ConfirmContent` rearranges its children: the header and every non-cancel button from `ConfirmFooter` go into one rounded group, and `ConfirmCancel` is placed below it as a separate button. Use it before destructive or irreversible actions.
usage:
Put `ConfirmTitle` and `ConfirmDescription` in a `ConfirmHeader`, and the buttons in a `ConfirmFooter` inside `ConfirmContent`. Any `ConfirmAction` goes into the group; `ConfirmCancel` is moved out of it.

The root accepts `open`, `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange`. Pass `dismissible` to let outside presses close it. Set `variant="destructive"` on `ConfirmAction` for delete-style actions.

examples.OpenByDefault: Shows the sheet on first render with `defaultOpen`.

parts.Confirm: The root that owns the open state.
parts.ConfirmTrigger: The element that opens the sheet.
parts.ConfirmContent: The sheet that groups the header and actions and places Cancel below.
parts.ConfirmFooter: Holds the action and cancel buttons.
parts.ConfirmAction: A confirming action, rendered as an `AlertSheetAction`.
parts.ConfirmCancel: The cancel button, shown separately below the group.

Confirm.dismissible: When `true`, an outside press closes the sheet. Defaults to `false`.

accessibility: - With the default `dismissible={false}`, the sheet uses the alert dialog primitive, so it closes only through its buttons.
notes:
- Action text uses `text-link`, or `text-danger` for the `destructive` variant.
- On iOS the sheet renders in a full-window overlay so it appears above native screens.
